title: Alto Vetro, Grand Canal Square, Dublin 2

prs.location:
Alto Vetro is on the west side of Grand Canal Dock, a popular area for the arts and enterprise, making the Bord Gais Energy Theatre, 3Arena and a host of international companies from Google to Accenture part of your neighbourhood. 

If you want to stay local, the Art of Coffee is in the building. The celebrated Marker Hotel is 500 metres away, affording you a choice of spa treatments, fine food and tempting cocktails. While Il Valentino is the quintessential Italian bakery and café on Grand Canal Harbour, tempting every sense.

Getting around the city is easy in this connected location with Grand Canal Dock Dart station only five minutes away and Dublinbikes at your door. The best of Dublin’s activities await you from shopping on Grafton Street to coastal walks along Sandymount Strand.

description:
These remarkable 2 and 3 bedroom apartments are part of a boutique collection of 26 tower residences overlooking city life in the cosmopolitan Grand Canal Dock. 

Mornings feel brighter with oversized windows capturing the sunlight in this award-winning skinny scraper. Sit back and soak in the colour and energy of the capital with incredible views from the five star interiors of this pristine glazed tower. 

Each living space invites the natural light in throughout the day, highlighting the gorgeous design detail and finish. The sense of imagination goes all the way to the top with a roof terrace, surrounded by a high glass balustrade, giving you a cinematic experience of the city. 

Dedicated property managers make life easy. Ready to help in any way, these friendly professionals tend to service requests and more, along with maintaining the privacy and safety of the building.

The Art of Coffee onsite adds another level of convenience to your daily life. 

Join a small community of city lovers and style aficionados who make the most of what Dublin has to offer, day and night. 

Virtual tours enable you to view apartments while respecting social distancing guidelines. They are helpful in illustrating the layout and interior style of a sample residence.
